story.body: You stood at the nail. The plot named the oath, the ladies, the Muscovites, and a messenger in black. The margin was blank. The gown hung beside it.

title: Looked at the plot before anyone spoke

description: The watchet gown, and the song

participation.context: Ordered the gown and the song first, set Sam left of Nick, and kept the column blank.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Taught the song on the breath, not on the word, and named the loss a right one.

participation.context: Forgot where to stand and remembered every note.
participation.name: Sam Latchet

story.body: You let Nick move in the unpaid gown. You stood out of Sam's light while Phillips taught the breath. Sam lost his place and kept the notes. You left the tally open.

story.body: You let Sincler come in in black. You did not give him more words. You said to come slower, then nothing, and to let them do it. Kemp stayed quiet. The half-line was left as it was.

story.body: At the end of the full rehearsal Heminges set down the running time and drew a line under it. You said nothing to it.

participation.context: Read the three cues, left the comedy shut, and went to play.

story.body: You read the cues and did not write a name over them. You left the comedy shut. You went to the Keys at two.
